mechanism: After three same-wallet, same-coin, same-side taker child orders with 20-to-40-second start gaps, one direction-locked HGBT regressor predicts same-direction gross return to the fourth-child completion or the causal 40-second cadence invalidation. A structural stop remains beyond the first-three-child origin, and a trade requires predicted gross return above 20bp before 12/18/24bp replay.
interpretation: The fourth child arrives often, but its completion produces effectively zero average same-direction price impact and a negative median. The fixed regressor predicts outcome rank worse than chance-direction monotonicity and worse absolute error than the train-mean baseline. Its maximum predicted gross return is only 5.14bp, far below the frozen 20bp authorization threshold. The strong order-cadence phenomenon therefore does not transport into a realistic-cost trading payoff.
retirement_boundary: Do not tune the cadence gaps, features, HGBT parameters, fourth-child exit, 40-second invalidation, structural stop, authorization threshold, risk or leverage under this source dependency. Reopen only with a materially different point-in-time information source capable of producing cost-sized executable Bybit displacement.
